about: Shared test values for 'where am I' (round 19, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md m-7 section 6, decision 58). Each client feeds the readings of a case in order, to a fresh locator per case, and must give the expected state after every reading. Written by the Android session; the site tests against the same file (as X-3, tools/fixtures/slope-x3.json).
data: site/data/runs-and-lifts.json (named runs, their segments that are not areas; named lifts that are not inactive) and the bounds of the terrain model in site/data/terrain.json (dem x0, x1, y0, y1)
projection: x = (lon - 44.495) * 111320 * cos(42.51 deg), y = -(lat - 42.51) * 111320, metres, as site/js/app.js
rule: outside: the point is outside the terrain model's bounds
approx: the phone or browser gave only an approximate location (Android 'approximate'); a big circle, no snapping

lift: within 25 m of a lift's cable, and moving up along it (the position along the cable, measured from its lower end by the terrain model, grows) in three readings in a row on the same lift; checked before the runs, for any accuracy up to 50 m
low: accuracy over 30 m and not on a lift
run: the nearest run (distance to its lines) is within 30 m; if the run of the reading before is also within 30 m and less than 10 m farther, it stays
free: none of the above (accurate, but not on a run)

cases.name: between two runs: stays on the one before
between two runs, nothing before: the nearer one
on the lift, going up: the lift on the third reading
near the lift, going down: never the lift
in the village, away from the runs
